task_ownership_additions.note: kernel/ composes centers+terrain+projections+scheduler into the pure NcmKernel (observe/recall/advance/consolidate/serialize); owned by the consolidation task because it is the first task that needs the whole composition. tests/kernel.rs is the kernel suite of task 010. Task 018 was granted the pre-existing adapter suite tests/ncm_adapter.rs for the snapshot_bytes limit tests and a clippy allowance (coordinator decisions 7-9). Task 019 owns the conformance receipt generator under scripts/product/ncm/conformance/. Task 023's policy files were prepared by the backend coordinator before the join (see product/ncm/plan/join/); they are listed so the standalone gate's ownership fence admits exactly those files.

host_base_note: Host branch head merged into the backend branch on 2026-09-06 (feat/pluggable-memory-providers-v2 @ c6d89e251, includes the upstream PR #707 head). The standalone gate fences the diff from this commit, so host-owned changes are not reported as backend ownership violations.
